title: RETRACTION: Poly (Lactic‐Co‐Glycolic Acid)‐Encapsulated Endostar‐Loaded Calcium Phosphate Cement as Anti‐Tumor Bone Cement for the Treatment of Bone Metastasis in Lung Cancer
content:
RETRACTION: Q. H. Tian, C. Tian, Y. Y. Lu, B. C. Yan, K. Zhang, and C. G. Wu, “ Poly (Lactic-Co-Glycolic Acid)-Encapsulated Endostar-Loaded Calcium Phosphate Cement as Anti-Tumor Bone Cement for the Treatment of Bone Metastasis in Lung Cancer,” Environmental Toxicology (EarlyView): https://doi.org/10.1002/tox.24166.

The above article, published online on 23 February 2024, in Wiley Online Library (http://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/), has been retracted by agreement between the journal Editor-in-Chief, Paul B. Tchounwou; and Wiley Periodicals LLC. Following an investigation by the publisher, the parties have concluded that this article was accepted solely on the basis of a compromised peer review process. Therefore, the article must be retracted.
